verdict.rationale: Zoho Books ships a documented MCP integration plus built-in Zia AI natural-language layer that lets users create invoices, track payments, categorize transactions, and pull reports via plain-English instructions to LLMs like Claude/GPT, with customer quotes confirming real usage. Missing for 10: independent/third-party verification beyond vendor marketing, and detail on the breadth/reliability of NL commands versus structured API/UI actions.
